notes: Timing/token data was not captured (task notifications did not report total_tokens/duration_ms) — time_seconds and tokens are 0 and should be ignored.
Skill wins where identity matters: eval 2 (bundle install) is 4/4 vs 0/4 — the baseline cannot know 'my skills for backend' means Shalin's repo and installed two unrelated third-party skills instead.

Eval 1: baseline installed a same-named skill from the WRONG source (wondelai/skills) and made an install-all-then-remove detour (65 skills installed then removed); the skill resolved the correct source via catalog fallback.

Eval 3 is the skill's weakness: baseline OUTPERFORMED (3/3 vs 2/3). With-skill accepted the first exact-ish name match (236-install obscure repo); baseline dug deeper (second query + GitHub cross-check) and found the official Anthropic skill (11.8K installs). Improvement signal: ecosystem search should rank by install count / official publisher, not accept the first name match.
Assertion 'No global installation was performed' passed in both configurations — non-discriminating (neither config is tempted to use -g for these prompts).

All three with-skill runs hit the live catalog 404 and correctly fell back to the bundled catalog snapshot. Publishing the real catalog.md to Skills_By_Shalin/ in the repo will make bundle data repo-driven.
Baseline pass rates are highly variable across evals (0%, 67%, 100% — stddev 0.51), showing the baseline's behavior is unpredictable; with-skill is stable (67%–100%).
